cover_headline: Shourya Ambure Wins Bronze, India's First Track Medal at Dakar Youth Olympics
facts: The 17-year-old from Maharashtra clocked a personal best 13.59 seconds in the women's 100m hurdles final, 0.02 seconds behind France's Anna Peeters (13.57); China's Zhang Keyi took gold in 13.17
Ambure set two personal bests in one day — 13.77 in the semi-final, then 13.59 in the final — as India's only track and field athlete at the Games
Her bronze was India's eighth medal at Dakar: three silver and five bronze

end.headline: Shourya Ambure Wins Bronze, India's First Track Medal at Dakar Youth Olympics
end.line: The 17-year-old from Maharashtra clocked a personal best 13.59 seconds in the women's 100m hurdles final, missing silver by 0.02 seconds as India's only track and field athlete at the Games.
